title: Easy Grilled Australian Courgettes Skewers
description: A savory and silky Australian dish featuring courgettes, perfect for a kid-friendly meal, cooked to perfection over binchotan-charcoal for a smoky flavor.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan-charcoal grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Add the sliced courgettes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated courgette slices onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the courgette skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are tender and lightly charred.
Brush the courgettes with lemon juice during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the grilled courgette skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
